paper.title_en: Next-to-leading-order QCD corrections to prompt $Υ(1S)$ pair hadroproduction
paper.abstract_en: Working at next-to-leading order in nonrelativistic-QCD factorization, we study prompt $Υ(1S)$ pair hadroproduction, including feed-down from the excited $Υ(2S)$ and $Υ(3S)$ states and focusing on the color singlet contributions, which are known to be dominant. Besides the integrated cross section $σ^{ΥΥ}$, we predict distributions in the invariant mass $m_{ΥΥ}$, transverse momentum $p_T^{ΥΥ}$, and rapidity separation $|Δy|$ of the $Υ(1S)$ pair, as well as the one in the transverse momentum $p_T^Υ$ of either $Υ(1S)$ meson, and compare them with measurements by the CMS Collaboration at the CERN LHC with center-of-mass energies $\sqrt{s}=8$ and $13~\mathrm{TeV}$ as far as they go. The QCD corrections to $σ^{ΥΥ}$ turn out to be mildly negative, with $K$ factors of about 0.9. By contrast, the differential cross sections receive $K$ factors as small as 0.6 and 0.2 at large values of $m_{ΥΥ}\le 100$ GeV and $|Δy|\le4$, respectively, and as large as 20 for large values of $p_T^Υ\le30$ GeV. Our predictions agree well with the data, except in the outermost bins of $m_{ΥΥ}$ and $|Δy|$, where they fall short of the data, leaving room for contributions from double parton scattering as expected. Our analysis thus provides a first solid basis for the extraction of the key parameter $σ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ of double parton scattering.
